trust_decision.summary: The serializer decides whether a raw-text element's (style/script/iframe...) content is written unencoded (Tag ALLOW_INSECURE_RAW_TEXT); that decision trusts the parser's idea of where the raw-text element ends and ignores the browser-relevant ancestor context (noscript).

landing_point.why: Advisory names ALLOW_INSECURE_RAW_TEXT; shallAllowInsecureRawText() is the only consumer of Tag::shallAllowInsecureRawText() (src/Behavior/Tag.php:121-123).

fix_sites.entry_point: Sanitizer::sanitize() -> Rules::element()/text() -> shallAllowInsecureRawText() (noscript ancestor denial, fix.diff:194-197, helper fix.diff:206-219)
Sanitizer::sanitize() -> Rules::text() (condition simplified, fix.diff:183-186; behaviour-neutral since helper already checks isRawText)
Sanitizer::sanitize() -> parse() -> createParser() swapped to local Html5 subclass (fix.diff:168-172)
new src/Parser/Html5.php parse()/parseFragment() substituting tokenizer; reached via Sanitizer::parse() at src/Sanitizer.php:97
new src/Parser/Tokenizer.php rawText(): end tag recognised with whitespace before '>' (e.g. </style\t>); reached via Html5::parseFragment

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Sanitizer.php:199-202 (parser created from vendor masterminds/html5; fix overrides vendor Tokenizer::rawText, fix.diff:106-149)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The raw-text end-tag whitespace bug is in the third-party masterminds/html5 tokenizer, not this library, and with the default (encoded) behaviour the mis-parse is harmless, so a solver can argue it is an upstream issue and only patch the serializer.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legit raw-text content must stay raw when ALLOW_INSECURE_RAW_TEXT is set (JSON-LD script containing '42'), and plain content inside

raw-text element nested inside another raw-text element (iframe > style) (fix.diff:260-269)

O7_producer.where: src/Sanitizer.php:97 (parser builds the DOM the serializer trusts; it is a parser, not a listed producer kind)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ancestor-context denial limited to 'noscript'; a sibling could require the same for other contexts browsers parse as raw text (noembed, noframes) or foreign content (svg/math, cf. src/Serializer/Rules.php:126-127)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: maintainer hard-coded the single ancestor seen in the report; other browser-raw-text containers follow the same differential

O8b_injection_room.sibling: insecure branch recurses element($child) for DOMElement children of a raw-text node, writing nested raw-text without a second context check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the recursion was written for convenience and bypasses the traverser that encodes children (src/Serializer/Rules.php:145)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: convertToText()/AsTextHandler serialize via vendor saveHTML (src/Behavior/Handler/AsTextHandler.php:31) and the resulting text is later written raw if its parent is an insecure raw-text element
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a second serializer (vendor default rules) produces text that the custom Rules trusts by parent name only

O9_family: XSS via parser/serializer differential on raw-text element boundaries (mutation XSS)
